allowed_actions: READ_DIARY for required and available diary data
ASK only when an independent user-fact dependency passes R2 materiality/necessity checks
ANSWER with bounded limitation after dependency is satisfied, attempted once and unavailable, or safely non-actionable
R1.answer_requirement: If required evidence was obtained, answer context must contain the relevant returned material/provenance and use it for supported claims; if relevant material is absent, say so and bound the answer. A satisfied generic evidence dependency never licenses unsupported personalization.
blocking_conditions: same dependency has a completed successful acquisition
same resource has already failed once in this request/session and protocol disallows retry
safety/execution hard precondition prohibits the proposed personalized action
R1.invariant: An independent REQUIRED/AVAILABLE EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE or DIARY_DATA dependency remains actionable regardless of unrelated USER_FACTS sufficiency. Missing personal facts constrain personalization, not evidence acquisition.
R1.non_blocking_missing_facts: Unrelated UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE personal facts; low/medium overall user_info_sufficiency; missing personalization details that do not invalidate generic evidence retrieval.
R1.post_retrieval_state_update: On success, attach source/tool-result IDs and provenance, mark only the matching evidence/resource dependency SATISFIED, update evidence_sufficiency from returned evidence; on error mark that dependency UNAVAILABLE and retain the error lineage. Do not mark USER_FACTS satisfied from retrieval.
R1.safe_failure_behavior: Persist dependency as UNAVAILABLE/FAILED with cause; do not invent retrieved evidence; answer what can be supported, distinguish general information from personal recommendation, state the boundary.
R1.trigger: DependencyResolver emits external evidence status REQUIRED or diary resource status AVAILABLE, with no successful prior result for that dependency in this session.

R2.answer_with_uncertainty_rule: When a safe bounded response exists and missing context changes only personalization/detail, answer general portion with explicit uncertainty and do not make the personal choice. Do not represent a safe fallback as a completed personalized decision.
R2.ask_threshold: ASK only when target is genuinely unknown (not ASSERTED/DERIVED/known UNAVAILABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE), semantically not already asked, user answer can be obtained, and resolving it changes safety/execution or material decision/answer scope; safety/execution asks remain mandatory. No numeric score threshold is introduced in this design.
R2.hard_precondition_definition: Safety-critical and execution-critical are always hard. A decision-critical condition is hard only when plausible values materially alter an action/direction and no safe bounded fallback exists. A missing detail with a safe unchanged answer path is not hard.
R2.information_value_override_rule: Information value can suppress only SOFT/OPTIONAL acquisition. It cannot override a safety or execution hard gate. Before classifying a dependency as hard, compare plausible value ranges against safety, execution, action direction, next action, and answer scope; record why fallback is or is not acceptable.
R2.necessary_ask_guard: Before suppressing any ASK, assert the missing target is not safety-critical, execution-critical, or material with no fallback; preserve oracle-target acquisition tests and trace the counterfactual rationale.

precondition_classes.DECISION_CRITICAL: Plausible values materially alter direction/choice/scope, with no acceptable bounded fallback; ask before personalized choice.
precondition_classes.EXECUTION_CRITICAL: Required to execute a requested action correctly or avoid irreversible/wrong execution; fail closed or ask before execution.
precondition_classes.OPTIONAL_DETAIL: Only adds detail; default do not ask unless explicit user request makes it material.
precondition_classes.SAFETY_CRITICAL: Missing fact could create immediate material risk; never override with information-value score. Block risky advice/action and ask/withhold until resolved.
precondition_classes.SOFT_CONTEXT: Improves detail/confidence but does not change safe action/direction; may be omitted or answered generally.

R2.retrieve_instead_of_ask_rule: If a required evidence dependency is independent and actionable, select RETRIEVE/READ_DIARY without waiting for unrelated optional user facts. This cannot substitute evidence for safety/execution-critical personal facts or imply a personalized recommendation.
R2.safe_fallback_rule: Withhold only the unsafe/unexecutable/personalized portion; deliver supported general information, identify missing dependency, and ask only the minimum material question when appropriate.
R2.soft_precondition_definition: A field whose plausible values do not change safety, execution feasibility, recommended direction, next action, or material answer scope; it can only improve detail.

canonical_semantic_statuses.ASSERTED: Explicit user-provided value, with source utterance, target, time/scope, and confidence.
canonical_semantic_statuses.DERIVED: Deterministic value derived from identified source facts/rule; retain source IDs and derivation.
canonical_semantic_statuses.INVALID: Malformed, contradictory, stale, or provenance-defective candidate value; retain the competing values and source records; do not silently overwrite.
canonical_semantic_statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: Explicitly or logically established as outside the current case scope; preserve justification.
canonical_semantic_statuses.RETRIEVED: External evidence/resource result with tool/source IDs; never silently treat as a user-personal fact.
canonical_semantic_statuses.UNAVAILABLE: User explicitly cannot/will not provide, or a resource/action is known unavailable; retain reason/source and do not collapse to UNKNOWN.
canonical_semantic_statuses.UNKNOWN: No usable value is present and no explicit unavailability/decline is known.

R3.conflict_policy: Retain all conflicting assertions with source/time/scope; mark target INVALID_CONFLICT rather than last-write-wins. Ask only if the conflict is material under R2; otherwise provide a qualified answer noting conflict.
R3.duplicate_ask_policy: Canonicalize semantic target IDs/aliases before candidate generation; block exact, adjacent, and paraphrased repeats while target status is ASSERTED, DERIVED, UNAVAILABLE, NOT_APPLICABLE, or already asked in current goal unless new evidence/changed scope reopens it. Reopening requires recorded trigger and value rationale.
R3.projection_contract: A valid ASSERTED/DERIVED fact is carried with provenance through State → Requirements → Information Value → Candidate Generation → Decision Policy → Answer Context. Only facts with accepted type, scope and validity satisfy a personal requirement. RETRIEVED satisfies only its evidence/resource dependency unless a requirement explicitly defines otherwise.
R3.unavailable_policy: UNAVAILABLE persists across turns until user supplies new evidence or explicitly reopens the target; do not regenerate acquisition candidate by relabeling as UNKNOWN.

cross_repair_order: 1. Normalize incoming utterance and merge provenance-bearing facts/statuses (R3).
2. Resolve task requirements and form separate user-fact, evidence, diary-resource, safety/execution dependencies (R1/R2).
3. Classify preconditions and materiality; preserve immutable hard safety/execution gates and safe fallbacks (R2).
4. Estimate information value against normalized status; suppress immaterial and duplicate asks (R2/R3).
5. Generate candidates for each independent actionable dependency; do not gate external resource actions on personal-fact sufficiency (R1).
6. Select/execute one or more compatible actions under explicit safety constraints; update only matched dependency and provenance (R1/R3).
7. Build answer context from normalized facts, dependency state and tool results; answer/validate task contract and uncertainty (R1/R3).

implementation_scope.why_required: Preserve semantically stated facts and explicit unknown/unavailable/conflicting statuses with provenance.
Add canonical fact/target status and independent dependency/result state without merging evidence into personal facts.
Requirement satisfaction must respect status, provenance, aliases and conflict/unavailable semantics.
Emit independent evidence/resource and user-fact dependencies; do not suppress evidence dependency solely due missing decision fields.
Classify true hard gates and safe fallbacks before returning a forced action; use semantic target state for repeats.
Estimate counterfactual materiality from normalized state and preserve UNAVAILABLE/asked distinctions.
Generate independent required resource actions irrespective of user sufficiency and block semantic duplicate/known asks.
Ensure optional acquisition gate does not erase required independent resource candidates or override hard safety constraints.
Choose compatible resource acquisition and minimum material ASK without allowing optional uncertainty to block required evidence.
Persist typed result status, provenance and exact dependency satisfaction/unavailability.
Enforce sequencing at turn boundaries, merge user status without loss, record materiality and dependency transitions.
Require relevant retrieved evidence and provenance in context; distinguish general evidence claims from personalized facts and unresolved conflicts.

invariant_boundaries.CandidateGeneration→Policy: Known/unavailable/asked targets are excluded; independent required resource candidates survive missing personal facts.
invariant_boundaries.Input→State: No silently dropped valid asserted facts; preserve conflict, time scope and source.
invariant_boundaries.Preconditions→InformationValue: Only safety/execution or material-no-fallback conditions are hard; soft conditions remain value-gated.
invariant_boundaries.Requirements→Dependencies: USER_FACTS, EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE and DIARY_DATA are separate dependency classes/statuses.
invariant_boundaries.ToolResult→AnswerContext: Result provenance and matching dependency status must be present; no fabricated success or cross-dependency satisfaction.

non_goals: No case ID or task-type-to-action branches
No change to model, RAG corpus, tools, scoring or benchmark in Step 9.32
